title: Estimating the number of real zeros of linear combinations of radicals of polynomials
summary: We obtain upper bounds for the number of real zeros of functions of the form $$ f(x) = \sum_{k=1}^{n} c_k \bigl(P_k(x)\bigr)^{α_k}, $$ where $c_k, α_k \in \mathbb{R}$ and each $P_k$ is a real polynomial of degree at most $d$ that is non-negative on an interval $I\subset \mathbb{R}$. We improve previously known exponential upper bounds for the number of roots on $I$ to bounds that are polynomial in $n$, linear in $d$, and independent of the exponents $α_k$.
